messages:
alisa: heads up — small GPU pods (0.125 GPU) stuck Pending then mass-evict in eu-west2 this morning, ~28 evictions between 02:45-03:10 UTC.

matt: any scheduler/kubelet rollout around that time?

alisa: none. kubelet logs on a subset of nodes show attach/detach timeouts + NVLINK link resets. heartbeat p95 spikes visible.

sangeeta: autoscaler metrics show node-heartbeat p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~7s at 02:50 UTC. scheduler will treat nodes as unstable and avoid packing them.

matt: that behavior fragments tiny-gang placements — we end up scattering 0.125g pods and backfill preempts the scattered ones.

devon: pasted relevant excerpts:
```
I0407 02:49:58 kube-scheduler: binding failed for pod/train-abc: lease timeout
I0407 02:50:02 kube-scheduler: fallback binding -> node-b
I0407 02:50:07 kubelet: nvlink: link-state-change: peer reset
I0407 02:50:12 eviction-controller: Evicting pod/train-abc due to preempt
```

opsbot: Alert: evictions-eu-west2 spike detected (28 events). Incident created: INC-5221.

matt: short-term mitigation proposal: canary a scheduler profile in a single AZ that increases lease grace to 25s, enables a nodeRecoveryCooldown (60s) and reduces tiny-pod backfill sensitivity (tiny-pod-weight -> 0.3). This should prevent short heartbeat blips from triggering rebind+evict.

sangeeta: +1. Add a Grafana panel for "tiny-pod eviction rate by AZ" and node-heartbeat p50/p95 so we can watch and rollback within 30m if needed.

alisa: creating canary pool in eu-west2c (60 nodes) and will apply the profile now.

opsbot: Deploy started: scheduler-profile -> canary-eu-west2c (job-6889).

devon: config diff ready:
```
leaseGracePeriod: "25s"
nodeRecoveryCooldown: "60s"
backfillTinyPodWeight: "0.3"
```

matt: if canary drops evictions, next step is root-cause NVLINK resets (driver/firmware/kernel) and consider scheduler smoothing logic so tiny-gang stickiness is less sensitive to transient heartbeat noise.

alisa: canary applied, monitoring dashboards up. Will report 15m and 30m findings. :eyes: :thumbsup:
